scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.deploy:data: rsync -avz --progress server/data/cards.json millenium-eye:~/deck-manager/server/data/ && rsync -avz --progress server/data/images/ millenium-eye:~/deck-manager/server/data/images/ && rsync -avz --progress decks/ millenium-eye:~/deck-manager/decks/ && rsync -avz ../ygo-collection/data/collection.json millenium-eye:~/ygo-collection/data/
